remarks: VIP Pricing. Sellers are considering offers starting at $899,900. Wow wow wow! With over 4,100 sqft of living space between three well-appointed floors & sitting upon over half an acre of land with vast views of the mighty Niagara River, this fantastic all brick waterfront Grand Island home is not to be missed! Entering through the large & inviting foyer from the remodeled front porch you'll be spoiled for choice as to which room to start with first! The formal living room enjoys waterviews & boasts handsome hardwood flooring & fireplace. Formal dining room also showcases hardwood flooring & waterviews. Cozy family room with pegged hardwood floors includes fireplace, wood beamed ceiling & builtin bookshelves. Huge great room with two full walls of windows, beamed ceiling, brand new LVP flooring & full bathroom would make a fabulous 1st floor primary suite! The roomy & updated kitchen offers quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, & a fabulous view of the private backyard. Finishing off the first floor you'll find a guest half bath & laundry/mud room with access to both the back yard & the attached 2 car garage. Second floor has four bedrooms, two of which have immediate access to full bathrooms & waterviews. The primary suite overlooks the water (ofcourse!) & enjoys a private remodeled full bath, walk in closet & access to the full attic. The second largest bedroom also enjoys endless waterviews & access to a third full bathroom (it's gorgeous!) which has a separate entrance for both the third & fourth bedrooms to access. The fully finished basement with egress window includes a large private room with closet (a sixth bedroom?) a kitchenette & a half bath. Outside the rear of the home you'll be completely enchanted by the mature landscaping, multiple patio areas, firepit, & inground gunite pool inside the fully fenced yard. 87' of waterfront includes several boat slips, jet ski lift, concrete walkway to & from home, & storage shed. River-fed sprinkler system! In summary, you'll be hard-pressed to find another stately 4/6 bed, 3 full & 2 half bath home on the water at this price! Don't wait. Showings & negotiations begin immediately. Sqft confirmed by Agent.
